adversarialCases.scenario: Repeated control-send failures; granted retry rung with nothing pending
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: One RequestIdr mirror per episode; exact 100/250/500 escalation; moot episode closes instead of false RestartIce/Fail

adversarialCases.scenario: Bare decode-flag NeedsIdr drained while sends are gated; recovery open across many ticks
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Unsent latch survives close(); persistent cadence until decoded-key ack

adversarialCases.scenario: Newer cumulative ACK behind an unsent stale value; epoch change
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Newest value wins within an epoch; epoch change replaces the slot outright

adversarialCases.scenario: Eight concurrent claimants racing a dying sender; store landing between liveness load and take
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Exactly one typed terminal reason; liveness-gated take plus take-first call site make the discard pair unrepresentable

adversarialCases.scenario: Renegotiation/generation-bump retirement of the old sender task
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: No terminal code, no IDR latch, no session teardown

adversarialCases.scenario: Deltas enqueued while needs_idr latched; key frame arrival
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Deltas rejected before any queue logic; keys always accepted and re-admit deltas via the consume path

adversarialCases.scenario: Dead FEC sender for a non-FEC-only (RTP) client
adversarialCases.expectedBehavior: Never terminates; recovery via IDR on the RTP path
